What_to_watch: The Copilot UAL Event Hub is not stalled or retargeted
Look_in: Azure Gov metrics and Activity log for the Event Hub namespace that ingests Audit.General Copilot events. S1 last CopilotInteraction time.
Fields_and_values: resourceId contains REPLACE_COPILOT_EH_NAMESPACE. Incoming vs outgoing on that hub. S1 Copilot CreationTime lag.
Pass_if: Last CopilotInteraction in S1 within 15 min of wall clock during business hours. No listen-policy or diagnostic destination change on that namespace outside PIM.
Tools: Azure Monitor; that Event Hub; S1
PIM_or_role: Azure PIM Owner on the Copilot logging RG

What_to_watch: No standing admins on roles that can change Copilot, Studio, RSS, or Copilot DLP
Look_in: Entra PIM Active vs Eligible for AI Administrator, SharePoint Administrator (RSS), Compliance/Information Protection (Copilot DLP and labels), Power Platform Administrator (Studio), Security Administrator (Security Copilot).
Fields_and_values: targetResources displayName in that role list. Eligible vs active. Copilot admin UAL RecordType 310-325, 384 must overlap a PIM window.
Pass_if: Zero standing active humans on those roles except documented break-glass. Copilot settings changes have a PIM activation.

What_to_watch: Sign-in to Copilot apps requires MFA and a compliant device
Look_in: Entra SignInLogs for Copilot appId only. Inventory Enterprise apps whose display name is Microsoft 365 Copilot, Security Copilot, or Copilot Studio. Do not use Office 365 as a proxy.
Fields_and_values: appId / appDisplayName containing Copilot. conditionalAccessStatus. authenticationRequirement. deviceDetail.isCompliant. errorCode=0.
Pass_if: Successful Copilot-app sign-ins: CA success, MFA, compliant device.

What_to_watch: Only approved users generate Copilot or Security Copilot interactions

Pass_if: Every CopilotInteraction UserId is licensed/approved. Guests = 0 unless AO exception.
